sources.field_scope: Guide qualifications, the discounted path for a long-licensed resident age 65 or older, and the coastal for-hire exemption. Those operators need a Coast Guard master or OUPV license and practical first aid and CPR, and they are exempt from the rest of RSA 215 while operating the licensed vessel in coastal and estuarine waters.
Every guide license expires with the calendar year.

RSA 214:9, XVI. Individual saltwater license, passenger exemption on a licensed for-hire vessel, per-vessel charter and party fees set by the executive director, and definitions of for-hire vessel, charter boat, and party boat.

Fis 1110.09. Charter or other for-hire vessel with 6 or fewer passengers, except party boats: $50 plus the agent fee. Party boat: $100 plus the agent fee. The fee paragraph's source note includes document #13874, effective February 23, 2024.
